en: Illustrated military-themed postcard showing a uniformed soldier walking at the front of a column of pack donkeys laden with crates and sacks. The man smokes a cigarette while leading the animals. The scene is bordered on the left and top by a pattern of black, red, and white squares. Handwritten-style text in two languages appears at the top, and a signature and date are on the left side.
